unlisted_practices: Building benchmarks from real EHR data that target known reasoning error categories (retrieval, aggregation, conditional logic)
Prompt refinement to improve retrieval accuracy of LLM agents on EHR tasks
Clinician quality audit of generated benchmark tasks

screen.reason: The study introduces and evaluates LLM agents on ART, a benchmark for action-based multi-step clinical reasoning over structured EHR data, focusing on failure modes without testing a specific organizational deployment practice.
